title.narrative: Supporting Member States with quality teacher education

description.narrative: Teachers are key to achieving inclusive, equitable, quality education and lifelong learning opportunities for all. As one of the most important school-level factors with impact on students´ learning outcomes, quality teachers are a cornerstone of quality learning. Pre-service and in-service teacher education, including continuous professional development, are key for the development of quality teachers within a lifelong learning perspective. Yet, at international, national and sub-national levels, there is still need of further understanding and monitoring how teachers are learning as learners themselves within teacher education processes. As a diagnosis, such evidence is needed to better inform and tailor teacher education policy. UNESCO Montevideo will support MS capacity to strengthen evidence-based teacher education policy with the overall objective of improving the quality of teachers. This will be achieved via country level and sub-regional activities that: a) generate evidence on the organization of teacher education to better situate informed policy interventions that address challenges at policy, governance and curricular levels; b) share knowledge and advocate for quality teachers where they are needed the most; c) build partnerships with relevant teacher education stakeholders at country level for a joint identification of teachers´ needs and coordinated country support.
